summary: Tested admin feature to reassign responsible employee (createdBy) for orders. Fixed critical bug: AssignUserDropdown was looking for 'token' in localStorage but AuthContext stores as 'authToken'. All backend API tests pass (8/8). Frontend dropdown now works correctly.

bug_fixed.issue: Component was using localStorage.getItem('token') but auth context stores as 'authToken'. This caused 401 errors when fetching users for the dropdown.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed localStorage.getItem('token') to localStorage.getItem('authToken') on lines 63 and 88

features_tested.details: Successfully assigns new responsible user, tracks changes in changeHistory
Successfully assigns new responsible user for balia orders
Returns 15 users, filters to 9 admin/employee for dropdown
Shows dropdown for admins in both AdminOrdersPage and OrdersPage. Successfully fetches users and updates order on selection
createdBy changes are tracked with timestamp, changedBy, oldValue and newValue

critical_code_review_comments: Minor data issue: Two users share the same ID 'e4d04ee8-517b-44eb-b4c7-734ad58e015b' (NewAdmin and ww) - causes React key warning but doesn't break functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order assignment feature (change responsible employee) is fully working. The AssignUserDropdown component had a bug where it used wrong localStorage key for auth token - this was fixed. Both sauna and balia assign endpoints work correctly. Admin can reassign any order to any admin/employee user.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: AssignUserDropdown.jsx used localStorage.getItem('token') but AuthContext.jsx stores the token as 'authToken'
rca_of_the_issue.symptoms: 401 Unauthorized error when fetching users, dropdown showed 'Brak użytkowników' (No users)
rca_of_the_issue.impact: High - feature was completely broken without this fix
